checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is Merkle inclusion proof for blob_kzg_commitments correctly validated before accepting BlobSidecar?

reachability.notes: Attacker could craft sidecar with forged inclusion proof.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the is_valid_merkle_branch function and all code paths that invoke it for BlobSidecar validation. 2. Verify the generalized index used for blob_kzg_commitments matches the SSZ spec (BLOB_KZG_COMMITMENTS_GINDEX). 3. Attempt to submit a BlobSidecar with a valid hash_tree_root(sidecar.kzg_commitments) but an incorrect Merkle branch (wrong sibling hashes). 4. Attempt to submit a BlobSidecar with correct branch structure but pointing to wrong field index. 5. Verify that sidecars with forged or truncated proofs are rejected before any state changes occur. 6. Check for off-by-one errors in depth calculation or branch length validation. 7. Verify the BeaconBlockBody root used for verification is authentic and not attacker-controlled.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0020, Trust Boundary: tb-002, Source Invariant: p2p-SG-004-INV-002, Source Assumption: asm-003. This is a CRITICAL boundary check - accepting a sidecar with invalid inclusion proof breaks data availability integrity and could allow an attacker to inject malicious blob data.

checklist.title: Verify Beacon Node correctly rejects BlobSidecars with malformed Merkle proofs at P2P boundary

reachability.notes: Attacker could craft sidecar with forged inclusion proof.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the beacon node's P2P message handling for BlobSidecar gossip (blob_sidecar_{subnet_id} topic). 2. Verify Merkle proof validation occurs BEFORE the sidecar is added to any cache or forwarded to peers. 3. Test with: (a) empty proof array, (b) proof with incorrect length, (c) proof with all-zero hashes, (d) proof for wrong index. 4. Confirm error handling does not leak timing information that could aid proof forgery. 5. Verify the node does not propagate invalid sidecars to other peers.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0020, Covered Node: actor-beacon-node. Supporting check for trust boundary tb-002.

checklist.title: Verify Block Proposer generates correct Merkle inclusion proofs for blob_kzg_commitments

reachability.notes: Attacker could craft sidecar with forged inclusion proof.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the block proposer's sidecar construction logic. 2. Verify compute_merkle_proof uses the correct generalized index for blob_kzg_commitments field. 3. Verify the hash_tree_root computation for kzg_commitments follows SSZ serialization rules. 4. Test proof generation with edge cases: (a) maximum number of blobs, (b) single blob, (c) empty commitments list. 5. Cross-validate generated proofs against reference implementation.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0020, Covered Node: actor-block-proposer. This verifies the internal logic that produces the proofs validated at the boundary.
